title: Modular add-on experiment: Compliance, retention, and premium SLA pilot
creator: Aisha Khan
description:
Goal: Run a controlled pilot that tests modular enterprise add-ons (observability retention tiers, a bundled compliance-pack, and a tiered premium SLA) with 3 pilot customers and validate revenue uplift, net promoter impact, and operational cost delta.

Motivation: Sales and Solutions Engineering frequently field asks for longer observability retention, contractual SLA commitments, and a tightly-scoped compliance package (audit logging, KMS integration, data residency) as purchasable extras. We need a lightweight, legal-friendly packaging and gating approach that is easy to sell, instrument, and operate before rolling into standard pricing.

Scope: Design experiment mechanics (catalog definitions, pricing, gating/activation flow), implement Console UI flagging and billing metadata, capture contract/security questionnaire answers for the compliance pack, and produce standard contract language snippets for legal. Pilot to 3 customers (one AI-native startup, one mid-market SaaS, one regulated enterprise).

Out-of-scope: Full marketplace/portal for self-serve procurement. Full on-prem install bundling for now (Private deployment customers will be handled via dedicated sales motion).
acceptance_criteria: A1: Console allows selecting & purchasing three add-ons independently (Observability Retention, Compliance Pack, Premium SLA) and displays effective price before checkout.
A2: Billing records contain add-on metadata (SKU, tier, start_date, billing_unit) and can be exported to finance exports.
A3: Security questionnaire pre-filled template produced for sales to attach to contracts; engineering has implemented required audit-log export and KMS flags for the Compliance Pack demo environment.
A4: Pilot customers onboarded, contract amendments signed, and usage telemetry streams captured for 30 days post-activation.
A5: Runbook for premium SLA (on-call escalation, incident timeline, credits calculation) documented and validated with SRE and Legal.
A6: Performance regressions <5% p50 token latency for typical workloads when retention caching and added observability flags are enabled.
A7: Decision gate held at the end of pilot with quantitative metrics and stakeholder sign-off (Finance, Sales, Legal, SRE, Product).
proposed_pricing: Observability retention: modular tiers - Standard (30d, included), Extended (90d) = $0.10 per GB-month, Archive (365d) = $0.03 per GB-month; first 100GB free for pilot customers.

Compliance Pack: one-time onboarding fee $5k + $1,000/month per organization for audit log exports, pre-filled security questionnaire, and priority legal support. Includes KMS integration guide (customer-managed key).

Premium SLA: three levels - Bronze (99.9% uptime, 8-hour response) $2k/mo; Silver (99.95%, 4-hour response) $6k/mo; Gold (99.99%, 1-hour response + dedicated postmortem) $18k/mo. SLA pricing pro-rated by commit window for pilot contracts.
Bundled option: Extended retention + Compliance Pack + Silver SLA = 10% bundle discount for annual commitment.
rollout_plan: Step 0: Legal & SRE alignment on sample contract language and runbook (due 2025-02-01).
Step 1: Implement catalog & billing metadata (ENG) + Console UI mockups (DES review) - targeted for 2025-02-10.
Step 2: Sales enablement pack + security questionnaire template (PM -> Sales) - 2025-02-14.
Step 3: Onboard 3 pilot customers with 30-day telemetry window (Pilot start 2025-02-20).
Step 4: Monitor metrics, capture feedback, iterate pricing and gating rules after 30 days, produce recommendation brief (by 2025-03-15).
Step 5: Decision point: retire pilot and roll to GA / iterate / cancel.
metrics_and_success_criteria: Primary revenue metric: MRR uplift attributable to add-ons >= $12k across pilots by day 30.
Activation metric: >=80% of pilot seats enable at least one add-on within 7 days of contract signature.
Retention metric: Observability retention storage growth tracked and cost delta measured (engineered cost per GB-month vs billable rate).
Customer satisfaction: CSAT change measured via short survey post-activation; target >= +5 points relative to baseline.
Operational metric: number of incidents requiring SLA credits and average credit amount. Target: 0 SLA credit events during pilot, or credits < $500 total.
Signal quality: Security questionnaire accuracy and time-to-complete reduced by >=50% vs manual process.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Billing complexity spikes (invoice debugging) -> Mitigation: limit pilot to 3 customers and include finance weekly sync, exportable invoice line items with add-on tags.
Risk: Feature gating causes regressions or accidental data exposure -> Mitigation: QA checklist, toggles per-tenant, data path review by Security.
Risk: Sales asks for deeply discounted custom terms -> Mitigation: enforce pilot pricing floor and require Legal approval for deviations.
Risk: Overestimate revenue due to free trial incentives -> Mitigation: cap free credits and measure conversion to paid after trial window.
